home.title: AI consulting and AI-native engineers | NODINA
home.description: NODINA puts AI to work inside the business you already run and brings AI-trained senior engineers to ship faster. Talk to us about your project.
home.label: AI consulting · AI-native engineering
home.heading: Put AI to work in the business you already run.
home.lead: Two ways to get there. We work with you as consultants and build AI into the way you already work. Or we bring AI-trained senior engineers who ship your software faster than hiring would.
home.problemsTitle: Less manual work. Faster delivery. No science project.
problems: Document handling, data entry and lookups that your team does by hand today, done by AI with human checks where they matter.
Senior engineers fluent in AI coding tools, working in your codebase from week three, without equity or recruitment fees.
A scoped proposal with deliverables, success criteria and responsibilities before anyone writes code.
home.offersTitle: Optimize what you have. Or build faster.
home.systemsBody: For leaders who want AI inside their current operations. We find the processes worth automating, build the solution, connect it to your data and tools, and hand it over working.
systemsItems: Search and answers across your internal knowledge
Workflows connected across the software you already use
home.teamsBody: For leaders with a roadmap and not enough engineers. We assemble senior engineers trained on AI tools, selected on real work, and integrate them into your team.
teamsItems: Team approved in one week, first pull requests from week three
Engineers in your repositories, tools and rituals
No equity stake, no recruitment fees
home.proofTitle: Senior judgment, not a sales deck.
home.proofBody: NODINA is led by Jean-David Collard: fifteen-plus years building products and engineering teams in France and the United States, and a PhD in computer science. Every engagement is scoped by someone who has shipped, hired and been accountable for the result.
home.methodTitle: Three steps from first call to results.
steps: A first conversation on your objective and constraints. You get a written proposal with scope, deliverables and success criteria.
We build the solution or assemble the team. You see progress in your own tools, with review and evaluation built in.
Deployment, documentation and handover. Responsibilities and follow-up are agreed before launch, not after.
home.closing: Tell us what is slowing you down.
home.closingBody: One conversation. A clear next step. If we are not the right fit, we will say so.

systems.title: AI consulting and integration for existing operations | NODINA
systems.description: Personalized AI consulting: NODINA identifies the processes worth automating in your business, builds the solution and integrates it into your data and tools.
systems.label: AI Consulting & Integration
systems.heading: AI inside your operations. Clean, connected, running.
systems.context: You know AI should be saving your company time. You do not want a pilot that never leaves the lab, or a vendor who rebuilds everything.
systems.lead: NODINA starts from the business you already run. We identify the processes where AI pays off, build the solution, connect it to your data and software, and hand it over working, with the people who use it trained.
systems.casesTitle: Start with the process that costs you most.
cases: Invoices, contracts, forms, reports: information extracted, checked and pushed into your business tools.
Your team asks a question and gets a sourced answer from your documents, with access rights respected.
Actions chained across the software you already use, with a human checkpoint where the decision matters.
systems.examplesNote: Examples, not a menu. Each solution is scoped around your data, tools and constraints. AI can also be added to a product you already sell.
systems.deliveryTitle: A working solution, not a slide deck.
deliverables: The process to improve, the data involved, the constraints and the criteria that define success. If an off-the-shelf tool already does the job, we tell you.
Code, integrations and evaluations against your real cases. Engineering decisions are documented so your team is never dependent on us.
Deployment, documentation and training for the people who use it. Operations, maintenance and responsibilities are written into the proposal.
systems.fitTitle: The right fit in three questions.
systems.fitBody: We take on engagements where the problem is real and someone owns it. Before we start, we agree on what the problem costs you today, what the solution must make possible, and a first scope.
fitPoints: A business owner who wants the problem solved
Data and tools we can access within an agreed framework
A way to measure whether the solution is worth it
systems.closingBody: Describe what slows your team down. We will tell you whether AI can fix it, and how we would do it.
systems.alternative: Need engineers rather than a delivered solution?

teams.title: AI-native Teams: AI-trained senior engineers | NODINA
teams.description: Senior engineers fluent in AI tools, selected on real work and integrated into your team. Approved in one week, no equity or recruitment fees.
teams.label: AI-native Teams
teams.heading: Senior engineers who build with AI. In your codebase from week three.
teams.context: Your roadmap is bigger than your team. Hiring takes months, and most candidates have never shipped with AI tools.
teams.lead: NODINA assembles senior engineers trained on AI coding tools and selected on real work, then integrates them into your team. You keep control of priorities. They ship in your repositories, with your tools and rituals.
teams.scopeTitle: One senior hire or a full team.
scope: Full-stack, backend and product engineers who turn your roadmap into merged pull requests.
Engineers who use AI coding tools well: context, verification and evaluation, not copy-paste.
Architecture and technical leadership to help your existing team make better decisions.
teams.selectionBody: Experienced CTOs and lead developers review each engineer’s code, their use of AI tools and how they work with a team. We select across Europe and Latin America so working hours overlap with yours.
teams.workingTitle: Approved in one week. Shipping from week three.
working: From your brief, we propose engineers. You meet them and approve the team and working arrangement.
Repository access, environment, tools and product context prepared with your team.
Engineers work in your codebase on your priorities. Scope, pace and terms are in the proposal. No equity, no recruitment fees.
teams.note: Timeline from a complete brief, subject to engineer availability and access preparation.
teams.closing: How many engineers do you need?
teams.closingBody: Tell us about your product, your stack and what is on the roadmap. We will propose a team and a start date.
teams.alternative: Prefer that we deliver the solution ourselves?
